name: G7 T3 W02 Part 2 - Build a column chart
description: Build a column chart. 2 words. Required: Flashcards and Fill in Blank. Read the Spark with the same name. Use this part in its Technology class.

words.definition: Information arranged in rows and columns.
words.example: The table puts club names beside their student counts.

words.definition: A picture that shows data so it is easier to compare.
words.example: The chart uses bars to compare the club counts.
